title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“当然是因为我喽。”大楼天台的栏杆上，一只浑身漆黑的乌鸦慢条斯理地梳理着自己的羽毛，猩红的眼眸里倒映着这位倒霉狙击手的身影，为自己刚才的操作点赞。这是陆白发现的白泽精怪图的新用法。相比于拥有灵魂和自主意识的人类，这些脑子只有核桃大小的鸟类似乎更好操控些。在陆白随便赋予了一只乌鸦比翼鸟的天赋能力【森罗】之后，他便多出了一具好用的动物分身。此时，看到自己挑选的第一个工具人立场竟然这么不坚定，马上就要杀人放火受招安了，他果断出手挑事。白泽精怪图中愿力的来源有很大可能来自于人们情绪剧烈的起伏，像现在这么平平淡淡的剧情可不是他想要的。他要让纽约乱起来！！！......“啊啊——”纽约布鲁克林大桥，原本宁静祥和的画面在枪声响起后，像是被按下了暂停键。下一秒，意识到发生了枪击事件的纽约市民连忙熟练地找掩体就近蹲下。而来此观光的游客则尖叫着四散而逃。桥面上，只留下被狙击枪击中之后捂着脑袋的卢克，以及还不清楚发生了什么的警方伪装人员。“怎么回事，是谁开的枪？？！”出于一名老警察的直觉，老约翰发现情况有点不妙。他快步走向半蹲在地的卢克，走到一半，被女警克里斯汀拉住，向后急退。簌簌——一丝丝宛若实质的血雾从卢克体内迸发而出，被人拿狙击枪爆了头，受到强烈刺激的他体内源自陆白赋予的力量，毫无意外有一些失控了。一股极其狂暴的兽性冲散了卢克的理智。他双手撑在地面上，手臂和背部肌肉高高鼓起，撑破身上的衣服后，体型也在周围警方人员惊诧不敢置信的眼神下开始暴涨。两米，三米。在来自异世界力量的帮助下，卢克简简单单就突破了人类生理上的极限，体型达到了夸张的三米，全身肌肉虬结，泛着如同岩石般的坚硬色泽。“上帝啊，这，这......”尽管来之前老约翰已经看了卢克大发神威，徒手捏爆黑鬼的视频资料，但眼前的这一幕，还是对他的刺激太大了些，不亚于大白天活见了鬼。“卢克先生，请你冷静，刚才发生的枪击是误会，我们对您绝对没有任何恶意，请给我们一个解释的机会......”一旁的女警克里斯汀还想解释一下。她觉得卢克虽然现在丑了点，壮了点，但说不定也能坐下来和平交流呢。“吼吼！！”下一秒，一声凶戾无比的怒吼打破了克里斯汀所有的幻想。被体内狂暴兽性冲击得失去理智的卢克，此时只想撕碎眼前讨厌的一切。他双腿微曲纵身一跃，在周围的警方人员都没来得及反应过来之前，就来到了一名伪装成游客的黑人警员面前，右手向前用力一拍。

嘭！！甚至都没来及得说一句话，这名黑人警员身体爆成漫天血雾，染红了四周的地面。纽约警察局，原本还想让属下好好交流、不要再开枪的雷.凯利见状嘴角抽了抽，十分果断的下令开火。砰砰——手枪、步枪、霰弹，发出让人心脏都要停止跳动的轰鸣。被这位黑人同事死状吓坏了的警员们脸色发白，不顾一切清空着手里的弹夹。但。。。。。。这能轻易将地球上任何动物撕碎的火力，此时却被卢克体表那一层薄薄的灰色皮肤所阻挡。除了子弹携带的大量动能对他的行动造成了一定的阻碍外，这些火力没有发挥出任何该有的作用。相反，卢克表现得更加狂暴了，硬顶着警员们的交叉火力冲进人群。凡是被他触碰到的警员就像是被火车头撞了一样，死状凄惨无比，都找不出完整一点的尸体。“该死，这特么的是什么怪物？！！”还活着的警员毫无疑问崩溃了，丢掉手里的武器扭头就跑。“狙击手呢，开火，给我击毙他！！”这么大的伤亡看得警察局里的雷.凯利眼皮直跳，再也顾不得上面那些大人物提出的活捉要求，抓起对讲机怒声大吼。“是！！”各个制高点位置上，刚才才被痛批了一顿的狙击手们闻言精神一振，都拿出自己的看家本事，不约而同瞄准卢克眼睛要害开枪。嘭！嘭！！虽然五名狙击手里只有一人命中，但这一次卢克的屠杀行为终于被打断。他捂住自己被射中的右眼痛得嘶吼一声，随即又被更多射来的狙击子弹命中，身体不断后退。最终在趋利避害的本能下，卢克随手抓起身旁一台轿车当盾牌，在桥面上快速跳跃，一蹦就是十几米远。这种情况下，狙击手们就无法发挥作用了。毕竟现实不是童话，能一枪命中时速高达100kmh物体的王牌狙击手只在电影里存在。无法有效命中的他们只能眼睁睁看着对方离开，最后噗通一声，跳进了哈德逊河里。......
content_en:
"Of course it's because of me." On the railing of the rooftop of the building, a black crow was combing its feathers slowly, its scarlet eyes reflected the figure of the unlucky sniper, and praised its actions just now.This is a new use of Bai Ze's ghost picture discovered by Lu Bai.Compared to humans with souls and autonomous consciousness, these birds with brains the size of walnuts seem to be easier to control.After Lu Bai casually gave a crow the innate ability [Sen Luo] of a winged bird, he had a useful animal clone.At this time, seeing that the first tool he chose was so unstable and was about to commit murder and arson and be recruited, he decisively took action to stir up trouble.The source of the willpower in Bai Ze's ghost pictures is very likely to come from the violent ups and downs of people's emotions. A dull plot like the current one is not what he wants.He wants to cause chaos in New York!!!..."Ahh-" The originally peaceful and peaceful scene of the Brooklyn Bridge in New York City seemed to have been pressed on pause after the gunfire rang out.The next second, the New York citizens who realized that a shooting incident had occurred quickly found cover and squatted down nearby.Tourists who came here for sightseeing screamed and fled.On the bridge, only Luke, who was covering his head after being hit by a sniper gun, and the police officers in disguise who still didn't know what happened were left."What's going on? Who fired the shot??!" Based on the intuition of an old policeman, Old John realized that something was wrong.He walked quickly towards Luke, who was half squatting on the ground. Halfway there, he was pulled by policewoman Christine and backed away sharply.Whispering - traces of substance-like blood mist burst out from Luke's body. He was shot in the head with a sniper rifle. He was strongly stimulated by the power given by Lu Bai. Unsurprisingly, he lost control.An extremely violent animality washed away Luke's sanity.He placed his hands on the ground, and the muscles in his arms and back bulged. After bursting through his clothes, his body size began to skyrocket under the surprised and disbelieving eyes of the surrounding police officers.Two meters, three meters.With the help of the power from another world, Luke simply broke through the physical limits of human beings, reaching an exaggerated three meters in size, with muscles all over his body tangled and glowing as hard as rock."God, this, this..." Even though Old John had watched the video of Luke showing off his power and crushing a nigger with his bare hands before he came, the scene in front of him still stimulated him too much, no less than seeing a ghost in broad daylight."Mr. Luke, please calm down. The shooting that just happened was a misunderstanding. We have absolutely no ill intentions towards you. Please give us a chance to explain..." Policewoman Christine on the side also wanted to explain.She felt that although Luke was a bit uglier and stronger now, he might be able to sit down and communicate peacefully."Hooray!!" The next second, a ferocious roar broke all Christine's illusions.Luke, who was driven out of his mind by the violent beastiality in his body, just wanted to tear apart everything he hated in front of him.He slightly bent his legs and jumped up. Before the surrounding police officers had time to react, he came to a black police officer disguised as a tourist and slapped forward with his right hand.

Bang!!Before he even had time to say a word, the black police officer's body exploded into a mist of blood that stained the surrounding ground red.In the New York Police Department, Ray Kelly, who originally wanted his subordinates to communicate properly and stop shooting, twitched the corner of his mouth when he saw this, and decisively ordered to fire.Bang bang - pistols, rifles, shotguns, making a heart-stopping roar.The police officers, frightened by the death of their black colleague, turned pale and desperately emptied the magazines in their hands.but......This firepower, which could easily tear any animal on earth to pieces, was blocked by the thin layer of gray skin on Luke's body.Except for the large amount of kinetic energy carried by the bullets, which hindered his movements to a certain extent, these firepower did not play any expected role.Instead, Luke became even more violent, charging into the crowd despite the crossfire of police officers.All the police officers he touched were as if they had been hit by a locomotive. Their deaths were so miserable that no complete bodies could be found."Damn it, what kind of monster is this?!" The police officer who was still alive undoubtedly collapsed, dropped his weapon and ran away."Where's the sniper? Open fire and kill him!!" Seeing such heavy casualties made Ray Kelly's eyelids jump in the police station. He no longer cared about the demands of the big shots above to be captured alive, grabbed the walkie-talkie and shouted angrily."Yes!!" At various commanding heights, the snipers who had just been severely criticized were perked up after hearing this. They all used their special skills and aimed at Luke's eyes and shot them.Bang!Bang!!Although only one of the five snipers hit, this time Luke's massacre was finally interrupted.He covered his right eye that was shot and roared in pain, and then was hit by more sniper bullets, and his body kept retreating.In the end, with the instinct of seeking advantages and avoiding disadvantages, Luke grabbed a car next to him and used it as a shield, and jumped quickly on the bridge, covering more than ten meters in one jump.In this case, snipers will be unable to play their role.After all, reality is not a fairy tale. Ace snipers who can hit objects with a speed of up to 100kmh only exist in movies.Unable to effectively hit, they could only watch the other party leave, and finally jumped into the Hudson River with a pop....
